description: This file is a C++ source file implementing classes, enums, and functions related to plugin metadata, including service states, channel states, subsystem information, and JSON serialization/deserialization for a plugin framework.

classes.name: MetaData::Service::State
classes.description: Represents the state of a service with JSON serialization capabilities.

classes.name: MetaData::Channel::State
classes.description: Represents the state of a communication channel with JSON serialization capabilities.

classes.name: MetaData::Service
classes.description: Holds metadata about a service, including version, state, and other properties.

classes.name: MetaData::Channel
classes.description: Contains information about a communication channel, including remote address, state, activity, ID, and name.

classes.name: MetaData::Bridge
classes.description: Represents a network bridge with locator, latency, model, and security properties.

classes.name: MetaData::Server
classes.description: Contains server-related metadata, including thread pool status and pending requests.

classes.name: MetaData
classes.description: Main class aggregating various system and plugin metadata, including subsystems, plugins, channels, bridges, and version info.

classes.name: SubSystem
classes.description: Manages a collection of subsystem availability states within the plugin framework.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator for Service::State from a shell interface or another state.

methods.name: Data
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the current enum state.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a subsystem type and its availability status to the internal collection.
